chapter: Arriving in New York: the Nest Club and Harlem nightlife
title: Harry White has Simon Marrero sent for from New Orleans
summary: Harry White wanted a bassist like Albert Morgan or Pops Foster, so Danny and Paul sent for Simon Marrero, who got off in Newark by mistake.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Harry was a wonderful musician. He was an arranger. He arranged some things that Duke used. And he and I... He just liked me. So later on he asked me... Albert Morgan had come through and made a splash on the bass, and Pops Foster was with Luis Russell, and everybody was taking lessons from him. They couldn't get to Braud, because Braud was doubling with Duke, playing theatres and the Cotton Club. And he asked me, said, "Man, that's a helluva bass. Have they got any more down there like that?" I said, "Yeah." I said, "The boss is down there. Simon Marrero." That was Billy Marrero's son. He said, "Do you think you could get him to come up here?" I said, "Yeah, he ain't doin' nothin'." So I told Paul about it, and he and Paul got together, and they got Simon's address and sent for Simon.
Yeah, my uncle. So here comes Simon, with his bass. The man on the train said "New-Ark!" Simon got off and thought it was "New Yawk!"
Oh, he got off in Newark! [LAUGHING]

So we went to the railroad station, but Simon... That was a long joke for a long time around this town. Instead of him, you know, waiting... He didn't know... So he had to get another train, a local to come to New York, and it would be... He was missing. So when he got into Pennsylvania Station he called us, and we had to go down there and get him.

So he joined the band. It was a whole new concept. It was like me and him were swinging, and Smitty fell right in. The band was swinging like crazy with Simon. Because these people would usually use the bass drum, and here this man's playing these big, heavy notes, man, big, fat notes, and didn't say nothin'... The first day Simon come there, he said he didn't like the city, he said, "'cause all the buildings looks like hospitals."
That was the only big buildings down here, I guess.
